name: Kharnas's Lesser Glyph

source.title: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege

disable: Disable DC 46 Thievery check (legendary) to destroy the glyph, DC 42 Arcana check (master) to harmlessly divert the glyph's power, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the glyph
reset: The glyph can affect two creatures before it deactivates for 5 minutes and automatically resets.

items.name: Dominate
items.text:
Trigger A creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas attempts to open the door

---

Effect A surge of the Radiant Spark's latent power courses through the glyph and washes over the triggering creature. If the creature is undead, it takes 10d10 vitality damage. If it's living, it instead regains 10d10 healing Hit Points. It then must succeed at a DC 40 Will save save or be affected by a 6th-rank Dominate spell.

The spell commands the affected creature to attack the nearest creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas.

text: A hidden glyph suddenly lights up and dominates the mind of any creature not bearing the sigil of Kharnas the Angel-Binder.
